category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, replace tanh frequency scaling with bounded z/sqrt(1+z*z) scaling using the same standardized log1p training counts. Existing checkpoint buffers preserve these scales for prediction; padding and mask scales remain 1. Embeddings, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Change only the training-frequency feature’s saturation function for each category’s single BERT4Rec model; existing checkpoint and predictor plumbing remains compatible.
